Use the generally available Microsoft Foundry Agents service' but does not itself give the retirement date on the page content we could load; multiple Microsoft Q&A threads and third-party posts cite August 26, 2026 (matching OpenAI's own Assistants API retirement date), but we could not confirm that exact date on an official, non-forum Microsoft page — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/azure/foundry-classic/openai/concepts/assistants

For models launched on Bedrock on or after September 7, 2026, a new lifecycle policy applies with per-model-card 'EOL no sooner than' dates instead of a shared schedule page; GPT-6.1 Sol on Bedrock specifically follows OpenAI's own first-party deprecation notice periods rather than a separate Bedrock date — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-lifecycle.html
